desc:
🦅Defend against the British! Or defend against the Americans! During the War of 1812!

🥁Deploy troops to the battlefield and defend against the invaders 

This is a Tower Defense game about the War of 1812 (shoutout history)

The War of 1812 was fought by the United States and its allies against the United Kingdom and its allies in North America. It began when the United States declared war on Britain on 18 June 1812.

👍Give us a like if you enjoyed playing!
This game is in development! Expect bugs and things missing, along with some balancing problems.
